identity_lock.silhouette: Rounded navy beret, subdued ash-beige bob, compact navy A-line dress, thin tan strap, compact satchel and its single small rabbit remain unmistakable in every frame.
identity_lock.proportions: Approximately four heads tall with short legs, small feet, fixed torso length, both shoes planted, stable root scale and the same body margins as the canonical character.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Pale rounded face, muted blue-gray eyes, fixed fringe and matte cool ash-beige hair; only eyelids, a tiny yawn mouth and a restrained chin lift may change.
identity_lock.costume: Cream collar, orange ribbon, approved brass-button layout, loose long sleeves, lace hem, cream socks, black Mary Jane shoes, tan strap, compact satchel and small rabbit keep their exact topology and scale.
identity_lock.rendering: Soft polished miniature anime sprite with fine dark outlines, restrained warm cel shading, fixed orthographic camera and neutral light. The original front reference remains authoritative.

action_contract.intent: She feels stiff, releases the strap, rolls her shoulders open, raises both arms into a broad compact V stretch, gives a tiny sleepy yawn, briefly curls both hands into small relaxed fists, then lowers her arms and regrips the strap.
action_contract.opening_key: Both elbows lift outward and both hands rise beside the head; the strap stays across the torso even though the chest hand has released it.
action_contract.peak_key: Both arms extend diagonally upward and outward in a broad V, hands no higher than the beret top, eyes closed and mouth making one tiny yawn while the chest opens slightly.
action_contract.fist_accent_key: At the raised peak, both hands progressively curl into small relaxed fists for one restrained beat before the elbows begin to bend and descend.
action_contract.settle_key: The yawn ends, elbows soften and both arms descend in a wide relaxed curve before the strap-side hand returns to the strap.
action_contract.locked_elements: Shoes, feet spacing, root, body scale, hat, hair identity, collar, ribbon, buttons, strap route, satchel identity, rabbit identity and camera remain fixed.
action_contract.allowed_motion: Both arms and sleeves, gradual finger curl into two small soft fists, shoulder lift, a very small chest opening, restrained chin and eyelid motion, tiny mouth change, slight hem response and minimal satchel/rabbit secondary sway.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No aggressive or celebratory fist pose, no tiptoe, step, knee lift, large backbend, body elongation, camera zoom, removed hat, opened bag, enlarged or detached rabbit, duplicated anatomy, scenery, shadow, text or effects.

key_pose_sources.strategy: Generate each key as a complete full-character drawing from the canonical identity anchor and approved idle. After approval, generate every remaining motion frame separately with both temporal neighbors. Never construct motion by moving or blending image parts.

threshold_notes.max_area_drift: The approved action deliberately widens the silhouette with two raised sleeves while feet, torso height and body scale remain fixed.
threshold_notes.max_bbox_aspect_drift: The broad V stretch approximately doubles the upper-body width without changing character proportions.
threshold_notes.max_center_range_px: The gesture is nearly symmetrical, but the satchel and asymmetric strap permit limited horizontal centroid movement.

post_process.generation: Every motion frame is a separate complete-character built-in image-generation call using the canonical anchor and temporal neighbors.
post_process.forbidden: No cut-and-paste parts, local compositing, translated layers, optical flow, cross-fade, morphing or algorithmic interpolation.
post_process.background_removal: Use a flat #FF00FF source background, explicit magenta chroma removal, soft edge matte and despill.
post_process.final_downsample: Uniformly normalize complete drawings into a fixed 512x512 cell, preserving body scale, shoe center and the y=472 visible baseline.

frames.pose: strap hand releases and both elbows begin bending
elbows open and hands rise toward the shoulders
both hands beside the head, elbows lifted outward
arms extend farther and the tiny yawn begins
peak broad V stretch with open palms and eyes closed
raised fingers curl halfway while the high V remains fixed
both raised hands form two small relaxed fists
soft fists remain closed as elbows begin a gentle descent
fists lower beside the head and shoulders
hands reopen while arms descend in a wide curve
arms continue descending in a wide relaxed curve
hands lower toward waist and strap
strap-side hand regrips while free hand settles
shoulders and gaze return to neutral
